prompt: A cross-section of a deep slate quarry wall. Horizontal grey-brown rock layers. A cold blue-white necromantic glow seeps from a mineral seam crack at the base. Dark mine cavern, colorless earthen palette, black depths.

A quarry excavation dig site seen in cross-section. Loose rubble and dust. A cold blue-white necromantic glow rises from an exposed mineral seam beneath the bones. Dark underground mine cavern, colorless earthen palette.

Close-up of a slate cliff face in a deep mine. Horizontal grey and brown rock layers. Cold blue-white necromantic glow leaks from a glowing mineral seam crack along the bottom. Colorless earthen palette, black underground depth.
